versions.changelog:
- Updated skill description for improved clarity and broader coverage (added "Lead enrichment" and "GitHub profile data").
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

Initial release of GoCreative Enrichment — B2B context, company, and email data for agents.

- Enables lead and company enrichment by domain, work-email finding/verification, and LinkedIn profile lookup.
- No API key or signup required; pay-per-call in USDC using HTTP 402 + OpenClaw wallet.
- Live endpoints for firmographics, email 360 validation, domain/DNS/WHOIS intelligence, and bundled company intelligence.
- Simple HTTPS GET interface; examples and pricing included for each tool.
